أَحْنَى الظَّهْرِ A man having a [bent, bowed, or] humped back: fem., applied to a woman, حَنْوَآءُ and حَنْيَآءُ: (S:) the former fem. also applied, in the same sense, to a she-camel. (K.) ―
-b2- See also the former fem. voce حَانٍ. ―
-b3- فُلَانٌ أَحْنَى النَّاس ضُلُوغًا عَلَيْكَ (assumed tropical:) Such a one is the most affectionate, kind, or compassionate, of men towards thee. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
